title: For media and journalists
description: Press page for The Lord of the Rings — Battle for Middle-earth. Basic facts, media contacts, conditions for photography and filming, media kit.
subtitle: Basic facts, contact, conditions for reporting from the event.
ch_allowed: What can be photographed and filmed
ch_forbidden: What is not allowed without prior agreement
desc_strong1: The Lord of the Rings — Battle for Middle-earth
desc_mid: is a large fantasy larp battle inspired by the world of J. R. R. Tolkien. Participants in costume represent armies and peoples of Middle-earth and take part in a weekend-long game with emphasis on atmosphere, safety, fair play and community experience. The event is organised by
f_name_value: The Lord of the Rings — Battle for Middle-earth
f_age_value: 12+ (under 18 needs guardian consent, under 15 needs accompaniment)
f_armies_value: Gondor, Rohan, Elves, Dwarves, Orcs, Uruk-hai, Harad, Umbar, Highlanders of Vrchovina
contact_response: For on-site reporting please request accreditation at least 7 days in advance. State the type of media, planned format and number of people.
allowed_l1: General shots of the event and the camp.
allowed_l2: Costumes and atmosphere by agreement with specific participants.
allowed_l4: Combat — only from a safe distance, without entering the game area.
forbidden_l3: Using a drone without organiser permission.
forbidden_l4: Commercially using participants’ likenesses without your own legal basis (consent of those captured).
forbidden_l5: Photographing sensitive situations, medical interventions or children inappropriately.
mediakit_p: A press release, the event logo in multiple variants, and photos from past editions in print quality are available on request. Send us an e-mail and we will reply with a direct link.
mediakit_l1: Logo (SVG, PNG with transparent background, dark/light background variants)
mediakit_l4: Representative photos from past editions (high resolution, captions)
